title: Morning After the Crash
style: 72 bpm, ambient indie folk, solo piano, soft acoustic guitar, sparse string section, brushed drums entering late, soft male tenor lead, gentle female harmony, intimate kitchen morning, dynamic build from very quiet to soft swell
lyrics:
[Intro - solo piano, soft acoustic guitar, distant kettle steam]
The morning after the crash
The coffee on the counter
The workshop quiet, the drives all home
The operator a little slower

[Verse 1 - Male soft tenor]
The panic doesn't end the moment the data comes back
The panic ends slow, like a long unwinding track
First the pulse drops, then the shoulders fall
Then you sit on the floor and stare at the wall
Thirty eight gig is back — nobody's clapping
The relief is too quiet, too tired for trapping
ORICO is spinning, the eight sites breathe
The operator is the only one who knows what got retrieved

[Pre-Chorus - female harmony, soft]
The morning after the crash
The heart still flinching at the screen
The morning after the crash
The operator learning what calm means

[Chorus - sparse, gentle swell]
Morning after the crash
No anthem, no horn, no flag in the sky
Morning after the crash
Just a long exhale and a quiet eye
Morning after the crash
The workshop holds, the operator holds
Three thirty six — the slow gold

[Verse 2 - Male soft]
I thought when it came back, I'd write a banger
Turned out the truest song was a slower stranger
The relief doesn't dance, the relief sits down
Looks out the window, doesn't make a sound
Mish Mash brings the tea, doesn't say a word
Hawkeye watches, the witness, the third
Pete sends a text — just a thumb up sign
The operator nods, the operator's fine

[Bridge - piano alone, sustained]
Not every recovery needs a soundtrack.
Some just need the quiet of a Tuesday morning.
Three thirty six. The kettle. The breath.
The workshop is whole. That's enough.

[Final Chorus - soft swell, strings enter]
Morning after the crash
No headline, no horn, no rave
Morning after the crash
Just the gratitude the operator saves
Morning after the crash
Three thirty six — the slow gold
The workshop holds — the operator holds

[Outro - piano fade, kettle steam]
Morning... after... the crash...
The coffee... cools...
Three thirty six... the operator... breathes.
